q_en: How do I apply for an assignment extension?
a_zh: 【演示政策】请在截止前通过课程平台提交延期申请和证明，由课程负责人决定是否批准。
a_en: [Demo policy] Submit an extension request and supporting documents through the course platform before the deadline. Approval is decided by the course coordinator.

q_zh: 忘记学生账户密码怎么办？
q_en: How do I reset my student account password?
a_zh: 【演示政策】请使用学生门户的密码重设功能，验证失败时联系 IT 支援。
a_en: [Demo policy] Use the password reset feature in the student portal. Contact IT support if verification fails.

q_zh: 在哪里查看考试时间表？
q_en: Where can I find the examination timetable?
a_zh: 【演示政策】请在学生门户考试栏目查看，并核对课程编号和最新公告。
a_en: [Demo policy] Check the examination section of the student portal and verify course codes and current announcements.

q_en: How can I pay tuition fees?
a_zh: 【演示政策】请在学生门户查看缴费通知，按列出的方式和期限付款。
a_en: [Demo policy] Check your payment notice in the student portal and follow its payment methods and deadline.

q_en: How do I add or drop a course?
a_zh: 【演示政策】请在选课调整期内通过学生门户操作，调整期后请咨询课程办公室。
a_en: [Demo policy] Add or drop courses through the student portal during the adjustment period. Contact the course office afterwards.

q_en: How can I borrow library books?
a_zh: 【演示政策】请凭有效学生证借书，归还日期以借阅记录为准。
a_en: [Demo policy] Use a valid student card to borrow books. Check your loan record for due dates.
